reasoning: This project is a Kubernetes extension that provides two gRPC service binaries — the Endpoint Picker (EPP) and the Body Based Router (BBR) — which run as ext-proc servers to extend Envoy-based gateways into inference-aware gateways. While it defines CRDs (InferencePool) using kubebuilder and uses controller-runtime to watch Kubernetes resources, its primary purpose is not lifecycle management of other resources (as an operator would be), but rather to serve as inference scheduling and routing services. The EPP implements an inference scheduler that makes cost/performance-optimal endpoint selection decisions for LLM requests, while the BBR parses HTTP bodies to extract model routing information. Both are deployed as standalone services that integrate with Gateway API-compatible proxies via the ext-proc protocol. Classified as 'service' because its core value is the runtime request-processing functionality, not resource reconciliation.
